id-20260817-intro-real-estate-14.title: [Property #14] Buying Property is Easy, Maintenance and Taxes Are What Surprise You

segments.src: > Properti tidak berhenti menghasilkan uang di hari akad — ia terus meminta biaya perawatan dan pajak, dan selisih antara "yield brosur" dan "yield dompet" biasanya lahir di situ.
segments.tr: > Property doesn't stop making money on closing day — it keeps asking for maintenance costs and taxes, and the gap between the "brochure yield" and the "wallet yield" is usually born right there.

segments.src: ## Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Today's Concept

segments.src: Banyak orang mengukur properti dari satu angka saja: harga beli dan harga jual.
segments.tr: Many people measure property by just one number: purchase price and selling price.

segments.src: Padahal di antara dua titik itu ada masa kepemilikan yang bisa berlangsung 10–20 tahun, dan di sepanjang masa itu properti terus mengeluarkan biaya.
segments.tr: Yet between those two points lies a holding period that can last 10–20 years, and throughout that time the property keeps incurring costs.

segments.src: Inilah dua hal yang kita bahas hari ini: **manajemen properti** (mengelola aset agar tetap menghasilkan) dan **perpajakan properti** (biaya yang wajib dibayar ke negara).
segments.tr: These are the two things we discuss today: **property management** (managing assets so they keep producing) and **property taxation** (costs that must be paid to the state).

segments.src: **Manajemen properti** intinya menjaga agar pendapatan tetap masuk dan biaya tetap terkendali.
segments.tr: **Property management** is essentially keeping income coming in and costs under control.

segments.src: Ukuran yang paling sering dipakai adalah *Net Operating Income* (NOI):
segments.tr: The most frequently used metric is *Net Operating Income* (NOI):

segments.src: NOI = Pendapatan sewa efektif - Biaya operasional
segments.tr: NOI = Pendapatan sewa efektif - Biaya operasional

segments.src: Yield bersih = NOI / Nilai properti
segments.tr: Yield bersih = NOI / Nilai properti

segments.src: Kata kuncinya "efektif": kalau unit kosong dua bulan setahun, pendapatan Anda cuma 10 bulan.
segments.tr: The keyword is "effective": if the unit is vacant for two months a year, your income is only 10 months.

segments.src: Biaya operasional mencakup IPL/service charge, perawatan, asuransi, biaya agen, dan — ini yang sering dilupakan — pajak.
segments.tr: Operational costs include IPL/service charge, maintenance, insurance, agent fees, and — what is often forgotten — taxes.

segments.src: **Perpajakan properti** di Indonesia bisa dikelompokkan berdasarkan tiga momen:
segments.tr: **Property taxation** in Indonesia can be grouped into three moments:

segments.src: 1. **Saat memperoleh.** Pembeli membayar **BPHTB** (Bea Perolehan Hak atas Tanah dan Bangunan), tarif maksimal 5% dari nilai perolehan setelah dikurangi NPOPTKP (paling sedikit Rp80 juta; untuk warisan/hibah wasiat paling sedikit Rp300 juta). Kalau membeli unit baru dari pengembang, ada tambahan PPN, dan properti sangat mewah bisa kena PPnBM.
segments.tr: 1. **Upon acquisition.** The buyer pays **BPHTB** (Land and Building Rights Acquisition Duty), with a maximum rate of 5% of the acquisition value after deducting NPOPTKP (at least Rp80 million; for inheritance/testamentary grants at least Rp300 million). If buying a new unit from a developer, there is an additional VAT, and very luxury properties may be subject to PPnBM.

segments.src: 2. **Saat memiliki.** Setiap tahun terbit **SPPT PBB-P2**. Dasarnya bukan harga beli Anda, melainkan **NJOP** yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah. Tarif maksimalnya 0,5%, tetapi tarif riilnya ditentukan Perda masing-masing daerah dan umumnya jauh di bawah itu. Kalau unit disewakan, penghasilan sewa tanah/bangunan dikenai **PPh Final 10%** dari sewa bruto.
segments.tr: 2. **Upon ownership.** Every year the **SPPT PBB-P2** is issued. The basis is not your purchase price, but the **NJOP** determined by the regional government. The maximum rate is 0.5%, but the actual rate is determined by each region's Regional Regulation (Perda) and is generally well below that. If the unit is rented out, the land/building rental income is subject to a **Final Income Tax (PPh Final) of 10%** of the gross rent.

segments.src: 3. **Saat melepas.** Penjual dikenai **PPh Final atas pengalihan hak** sebesar 2,5% dari nilai pengalihan bruto (bukan dari keuntungan). Untuk rumah sederhana/rusun sederhana dari pengembang, tarifnya 1%.
segments.tr: 3. **Upon disposal.** The seller is subject to a **Final PPh on the transfer of rights** of 2.5% of the gross transfer value (not from profit). For simple houses/simple flats from developers, the rate is 1%.

segments.src: Poin penting yang membedakan properti dari deposito: pajak saat memiliki (PBB) dan pajak saat melepas (PPh final) dihitung dari **nilai**, bukan dari **untung**.
segments.tr: An important point that distinguishes property from deposits: the tax upon ownership (PBB) and tax upon disposal (Final PPh) are calculated from **value**, not from **profit**.

segments.src: Properti yang dijual rugi pun tetap kena 2,5%.
segments.tr: Even properties sold at a loss are still subject to the 2.5%.

segments.src: ## Dalam Keseharian
segments.tr: ## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bu Ratna membeli apartemen dua kamar di Bekasi seharga **Rp600 juta**, lalu menyewakannya **Rp3,5 juta per bulan** — Rp42 juta setahun.
segments.tr: Mrs. Ratna bought a two-bedroom apartment in Bekasi for **Rp600 million**, then rented it out for **Rp3.5 million per month** — Rp42 million a year.

segments.src: Di brosur agen, angkanya terlihat manis: 42 dibagi 600 = **yield 7%**.
segments.tr: On the agent's brochure, the number looks sweet: 42 divided by 600 = **7% yield**.

segments.src: Sekarang kita hitung dari sisi dompet, dengan asumsi unit terisi penuh setahun:
segments.tr: Now let's calculate from the wallet side, assuming the unit is fully occupied for the year:

segments.src: | Pos | Setahun |
segments.tr: | Item | Annual |

segments.src: | Sewa bruto | Rp42.000.000 |
segments.tr: | Gross rent | Rp42.000.000 |

segments.src: | PPh Final sewa 10% | −Rp4.200.000 |
segments.tr: | Final rental PPh 10% | −Rp4.200.000 |

segments.src: | IPL/service charge (36 m² x Rp15.000/m²/bulan) | −Rp6.480.000 |
segments.tr: | IPL/service charge (36 m² x Rp15.000/m²/month) | −Rp6.480.000 |

segments.src: | PBB (NJOP Rp450 juta, NJOPTKP Rp15 juta, tarif 0,2%) | −Rp870.000 |
segments.tr: | PBB (NJOP Rp450 million, NJOPTKP Rp15 million, rate 0.2%) | −Rp870.000 |

segments.src: | Perawatan & perbaikan kecil | −Rp3.000.000 |
segments.tr: | Maintenance & minor repairs | −Rp3.000.000 |

segments.src: (Angka NJOPTKP dan tarif berbeda tiap daerah — cek SPPT atau Perda setempat.)
segments.tr: (NJOPTKP figures and rates differ by region — check your local SPPT or Perda.)

segments.src: Yield bersih Bu Ratna = 27.450.000 / 600.000.000 = **sekitar 4,6%**, bukan 7%.
segments.tr: Mrs. Ratna's net yield = 27.450.000 / 600.000.000 = **around 4.6%**, not 7%.

segments.src: Dan itu belum menghitung risiko unit kosong: satu bulan kosong saja memangkas NOI sekitar Rp3,5 juta, menurunkan yield ke sekitar 4,0%.
segments.tr: And that doesn't count vacancy risk: a single vacant month trims NOI by about Rp3.5 million, dropping the yield to around 4.0%.

segments.src: Lima tahun kemudian Bu Ratna menjual unit itu **Rp700 juta**.
segments.tr: Five years later Mrs. Ratna sold the unit for **Rp700 million**.

segments.src: Yang masuk rekeningnya bukan Rp700 juta:
segments.tr: What enters her account is not Rp700 million:

segments.src: PPh Final penjual = 2,5% x 700.000.000 = Rp17.500.000
segments.tr: PPh Final penjual = 2,5% x 700.000.000 = Rp17.500.000

segments.src: Sementara pembelinya menyiapkan biaya sendiri:
segments.tr: Meanwhile, the buyer prepares their own costs:

segments.src: Ditambah biaya notaris/PPAT, balik nama, dan komisi agen.
segments.tr: Plus notary/PPAT fees, name transfer, and agent commissions.

segments.src: Jadi selisih Rp100 juta yang terlihat sebagai "untung" menyusut cukup banyak sebelum sampai ke tangan.
segments.tr: So the Rp100 million difference that looks like "profit" shrinks quite a bit before reaching her hands.

segments.src: Ini alasan pelaku properti profesional selalu memisahkan dua angka: *gross yield* untuk memikat, *net yield* untuk mengambil keputusan.
segments.tr: This is why professional property investors always separate two numbers: *gross yield* to entice, *net yield* to make decisions.

segments.src: ## Ringkasan 3 Baris
segments.tr: ## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Manajemen properti mengubah "punya aset" menjadi "aset yang menghasilkan"; ukurannya NOI, yaitu sewa efektif dikurangi seluruh biaya operasional termasuk pajak.
segments.tr: 1. Property management turns "having an asset" into "an asset that produces"; the metric is NOI, which is effective rent minus all operational costs including taxes.

segments.src: 2. Pajak properti muncul di tiga momen — BPHTB saat membeli, PBB tahunan plus PPh Final 10% atas sewa saat memiliki, dan PPh Final 2,5% saat menjual.
segments.tr: 2. Property taxes appear at three moments — BPHTB when buying, annual PBB plus 10% Final PPh on rent when owning, and 2.5% Final PPh when selling.

segments.src: 3. PBB dihitung dari NJOP dan PPh pengalihan dihitung dari nilai transaksi, bukan dari keuntungan — sehingga properti yang merugi pun tetap menanggung pajak.
segments.tr: 3. PBB is calculated from NJOP and transfer PPh is calculated from transaction value, not from profit — so even losing properties still bear taxes.

segments.src: ## ✅ Kuis Mandiri
segments.tr: ## ✅ Self Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Dalam transaksi jual beli properti biasa, siapa yang secara aturan menanggung BPHTB?
segments.tr: **1.** In a standard property transaction, who by rule bears the BPHTB?

segments.src: a) Penjual b) Pembeli c) Notaris/PPAT d) Pemerintah daerah
segments.tr: a) Seller b) Buyer c) Notary/PPAT d) Regional government

segments.src: **2.** (B/S) PBB-P2 setiap tahun dihitung dari harga transaksi terakhir properti tersebut.
segments.tr: **2.** (T/F) Annual PBB-P2 is calculated from the property's last transaction price.

segments.src: **3.** Berapa tarif PPh Final atas penghasilan sewa tanah dan/atau bangunan?
segments.tr: **3.** What is the Final PPh rate on land and/or building rental income?

segments.src: ## 📚 Istilah Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **NJOP (Nilai Jual Objek Pajak):** nilai properti yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah sebagai dasar penghitungan PBB; biasanya berbeda dari harga pasar.
segments.tr: - **NJOP (Tax Object Selling Value):** property value determined by the regional government as the basis for calculating PBB; usually different from market price.

segments.src: - **PBB-P2:** pajak daerah yang dibayar tiap tahun oleh pemilik tanah/bangunan, dengan tarif maksimal 0,5% sesuai Perda setempat.
segments.tr: - **PBB-P2:** regional tax paid annually by land/building owners, with a maximum rate of 0.5% according to local Perda.

segments.src: - **BPHTB:** pungutan yang dibayar **pembeli** saat memperoleh hak atas tanah/bangunan, maksimal 5% setelah dikurangi NPOPTKP.
segments.tr: - **BPHTB:** levy paid by the **buyer** upon acquiring land/building rights, maximum 5% after deducting NPOPTKP.

segments.src: - **PPh Final Pengalihan Hak:** pajak 2,5% dari nilai pengalihan bruto yang ditanggung **penjual** (1% untuk rumah sederhana dari pengembang).
segments.tr: - **Final PPh on Transfer of Rights:** 2.5% tax on gross transfer value borne by the **seller** (1% for simple houses from developers).

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income):** pendapatan sewa efektif dikurangi biaya operasional — angka inti untuk menilai kinerja properti sewa.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income):** effective rental income minus operational costs — the core figure for evaluating rental property performance.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) b — BPHTB adalah kewajiban pihak yang memperoleh hak, yaitu pembeli; penjual menanggung PPh Final 2,5%.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) b — BPHTB is the obligation of the party acquiring rights, namely the buyer; the seller bears the 2.5% Final PPh.

segments.src: 2) Salah — dasarnya NJOP yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah, bukan harga transaksi Anda; karena itu SPPT dua tetangga dengan harga beli berbeda bisa mirip.
segments.tr: 2) False — the basis is the NJOP determined by the regional government, not your transaction price; hence SPPTs of two neighbors with different purchase prices can be similar.

segments.src: 3) c — 10% bersifat final dari sewa bruto; jika penyewa adalah badan usaha, pajak itu dipotong langsung oleh penyewa.*
segments.tr: 3) c — 10% is final from gross rent; if the tenant is a business entity, that tax is withheld directly by the tenant.*

segments.src: *Catatan: tarif PBB, NJOPTKP, NPOPTKP, serta insentif PPN properti bisa berbeda antardaerah dan berubah dari waktu ke waktu.
segments.tr: *Note: PBB rates, NJOPTKP, NPOPTKP, and property VAT incentives can differ between regions and change over time.

segments.src: Sebelum bertransaksi, cek SPPT terbaru, Perda setempat, dan konsultasikan dengan notaris/PPAT atau konsultan pajak.*
segments.tr: Before transacting, check the latest SPPT, local Perda, and consult with a notary/PPAT or tax consultant.*

id-20260817-news-1.title: Behind the 2027 State Budget Figures: Prabowo Announces 145 Fertilizer Rules Abolished and New Capital Scheme for Market Traders

segments.src: Pidato kenegaraan pemerintah dalam rangka peringatan Hari Kemerdekaan sekaligus penyampaian Rancangan APBN 2027 tidak hanya berkutat pada angka-angka makro.
segments.tr: The government's state address commemorating Independence Day while presenting the 2027 Draft State Budget did not just revolve around macroeconomic figures.

segments.src: Di sela pembahasan asumsi dasar ekonomi dan arah belanja negara, pemerintah turut menyoroti dua isu yang menyentuh langsung kehidupan sehari-hari masyarakat: harga pupuk bagi petani dan akses permodalan bagi pedagang pasar tradisional.
segments.tr: Amidst the discussion of basic economic assumptions and the direction of state spending, the government also highlighted two issues that directly touch the daily lives of the public: fertilizer prices for farmers and capital access for traditional market traders.

segments.src: ## Klaim Penurunan Harga Pupuk 20 Persen
segments.tr: ## Claim of a 20 Percent Fertilizer Price Drop

segments.src: Pemerintah menyampaikan bahwa harga pupuk di tingkat petani mengalami penurunan hingga sekitar 20 persen dibandingkan periode sebelumnya.
segments.tr: The government stated that fertilizer prices at the farmer level experienced a drop of up to around 20 percent compared to the previous period.

segments.src: Penurunan ini diklaim sebagai hasil dari deregulasi besar-besaran terhadap 145 aturan yang selama ini mengatur alur distribusi dan penyaluran pupuk bersubsidi maupun nonsubsidi.
segments.tr: This drop is claimed to be the result of massive deregulation of 145 rules that previously regulated the distribution flow and supply of subsidized and non-subsidized fertilizers.

segments.src: Menurut penjelasan yang disampaikan, banyak dari aturan tersebut dinilai tumpang tindih dan memperpanjang rantai birokrasi, mulai dari proses pengajuan alokasi di tingkat daerah hingga verifikasi penyaluran ke kelompok tani.
segments.tr: According to the explanation provided, many of these rules were deemed to overlap and prolong the bureaucratic chain, starting from the allocation application process at the regional level to distribution verification to farmer groups.

segments.src: Dengan pemangkasan regulasi tersebut, pemerintah menyatakan proses distribusi menjadi lebih ringkas sehingga biaya logistik dan administrasi yang sebelumnya membebani harga jual dapat ditekan.
segments.tr: With the trimming of these regulations, the government stated that the distribution process has become more concise so that logistical and administrative costs that previously burdened the selling price can be suppressed.

segments.src: Sejumlah kalangan menyambut klaim ini secara hati-hati.
segments.tr: A number of circles greeted this claim with caution.

segments.src: Efektivitas kebijakan deregulasi kerap baru dapat diukur secara menyeluruh setelah melewati beberapa musim tanam, mengingat faktor lain seperti harga bahan baku impor, nilai tukar rupiah, dan ketersediaan gas sebagai bahan baku pupuk juga turut memengaruhi harga akhir di tingkat petani.
segments.tr: The effectiveness of deregulation policies can often only be fully measured after passing through several planting seasons, considering other factors such as imported raw material prices, the rupiah exchange rate, and the availability of gas as a fertilizer raw material also influence the final price at the farmer level.

segments.src: Pemerintah sendiri menyebut akan terus memantau implementasi di lapangan agar penurunan harga benar-benar dirasakan hingga ke petani kecil, bukan hanya berhenti di tingkat distributor.
segments.tr: The government itself mentioned it will continue to monitor implementation on the ground so that the price drop is genuinely felt down to small farmers, not just stopping at the distributor level.

segments.src: ## Skema Modal Baru untuk Pedagang Pasar
segments.tr: ## New Capital Scheme for Market Traders

segments.src: Selain isu pupuk, pemerintah juga mengumumkan rencana skema pendanaan khusus yang ditujukan bagi pedagang di pasar-pasar tradisional.
segments.tr: Aside from the fertilizer issue, the government also announced a special funding scheme plan aimed at traders in traditional markets.

segments.src: Skema ini dirancang untuk membantu pedagang kecil dan menengah yang selama ini kesulitan mengakses pembiayaan formal karena keterbatasan agunan atau riwayat kredit.
segments.tr: This scheme is designed to help small and medium traders who have previously struggled to access formal financing due to collateral limitations or credit history.

segments.src: Dalam paparannya, pemerintah menekankan bahwa pasar tradisional masih menjadi tulang punggung ekonomi rakyat dan penopang daya beli di banyak daerah.
segments.tr: In its presentation, the government emphasized that traditional markets remain the backbone of the people's economy and a pillar of purchasing power in many regions.

segments.src: Karena itu, dukungan permodalan diarahkan bukan sekadar untuk menambah modal kerja harian, melainkan juga untuk mendorong pedagang naik kelas, misalnya dengan memperluas jenis dagangan, memperbaiki tempat usaha, atau beralih ke sistem pencatatan dan pembayaran yang lebih modern.
segments.tr: Therefore, capital support is directed not just to add daily working capital, but also to encourage traders to step up, for example by expanding the types of merchandise, improving business premises, or shifting to more modern recording and payment systems.

segments.src: Detail teknis mengenai plafon pinjaman, bunga, dan mekanisme penyaluran skema ini disebut akan dituangkan lebih lanjut dalam peraturan turunan, menyusul pembahasan RAPBN 2027 di DPR.
segments.tr: Technical details regarding loan ceilings, interest, and distribution mechanisms of this scheme are said to be outlined further in derivative regulations, following the discussion of the 2027 Draft State Budget in the DPR.

segments.src: Pemerintah menyatakan skema tersebut akan disinergikan dengan program pembiayaan usaha mikro yang sudah berjalan agar tidak terjadi tumpang tindih sasaran maupun anggaran.
segments.tr: The government stated that the scheme will be synergized with ongoing micro-business financing programs so that there is no overlap in targets or budgets.

segments.src: ## Konteks di Tengah Pembahasan RAPBN 2027
segments.tr: ## Context Amidst the 2027 Draft State Budget Discussion

segments.src: Kedua kebijakan ini disampaikan sebagai bagian dari narasi besar RAPBN 2027 yang menitikberatkan pada penguatan daya beli masyarakat kelas bawah dan menengah, di tengah tantangan pertumbuhan ekonomi global yang masih dibayangi ketidakpastian.
segments.tr: Both policies were delivered as part of the grand narrative of the 2027 Draft State Budget which focuses on strengthening the purchasing power of the lower and middle-class society, amid global economic growth challenges still shadowed by uncertainty.

segments.src: Pemerintah menegaskan bahwa kebijakan fiskal ke depan akan diarahkan agar manfaatnya benar-benar dirasakan oleh kelompok yang selama ini paling rentan terhadap fluktuasi harga kebutuhan pokok, yaitu petani dan pedagang kecil.
segments.tr: The government asserted that future fiscal policies will be directed so that their benefits are genuinely felt by the group that has been most vulnerable to fluctuations in basic necessity prices, namely farmers and small traders.

segments.src: Pembahasan lebih rinci mengenai anggaran untuk mendukung kedua program ini akan berlangsung dalam rapat-rapat kerja antara pemerintah dan DPR dalam beberapa bulan mendatang, sebelum RAPBN 2027 disahkan menjadi undang-undang APBN.
segments.tr: More detailed discussions regarding the budget to support these two programs will take place in working meetings between the government and the DPR in the coming months, before the 2027 Draft State Budget is passed into the State Budget law.

segments.src: Masyarakat, khususnya pelaku usaha di sektor pertanian dan perdagangan pasar, diimbau untuk terus mengikuti perkembangan aturan turunan yang akan menentukan seberapa besar dampak nyata dari kedua kebijakan tersebut di lapangan.
segments.tr: The public, especially business actors in the agricultural and market trade sectors, are urged to continue following the developments of derivative regulations that will determine how large the real impact of these two policies will be on the ground.

id-20260817-news-2.title: The Fed Predicted to Cut Benchmark Interest Rate in September 2026, Here Are the Potential Impacts on the Rupiah and Indonesian Investors

segments.src: Pasar keuangan global tengah menakar arah kebijakan bank sentral Amerika Serikat, Federal Reserve (The Fed), menjelang pertemuan kebijakan moneter yang dijadwalkan berlangsung pada September 2026.
segments.tr: Global financial markets are gauging the policy direction of the US central bank, the Federal Reserve (The Fed), ahead of the monetary policy meeting scheduled for September 2026.

segments.src: Berdasarkan proyeksi sejumlah analis dan lembaga riset pasar, peluang The Fed memangkas suku bunga acuan sebesar 0,25 persen pada pertemuan tersebut diperkirakan mencapai kisaran 70 persen.
segments.tr: Based on projections by a number of analysts and market research institutions, the probability of the Fed cutting its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percent at that meeting is estimated to reach around 70 percent.

segments.src: Meski begitu, angka probabilitas ini bersifat dinamis dan dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu mengikuti rilis data ekonomi AS terbaru, termasuk inflasi, ketenagakerjaan, dan pertumbuhan ekonomi.
segments.tr: However, this probability figure is dynamic and can change at any time following the release of the latest US economic data, including inflation, employment, and economic growth.

segments.src: ## Mengapa Peluang Pemangkasan Bunga Menguat
segments.tr: ## Why the Probability of a Rate Cut is Strengthening

segments.src: Ekspektasi pemangkasan suku bunga The Fed umumnya muncul ketika data inflasi AS menunjukkan tren pendinginan menuju target bank sentral, sementara indikator pasar tenaga kerja mulai melunak.
segments.tr: Expectations of a Fed rate cut generally arise when US inflation data shows a cooling trend toward the central bank's target, while labor market indicators begin to soften.

segments.src: Dalam kondisi seperti ini, bank sentral biasanya memiliki ruang untuk melonggarkan kebijakan moneter guna menopang aktivitas ekonomi tanpa memicu lonjakan inflasi baru.
segments.tr: Under such conditions, the central bank typically has room to ease monetary policy to support economic activity without triggering a new surge in inflation.

segments.src: Namun perlu dicatat, keputusan The Fed tidak pernah bersifat pasti hingga benar-benar diumumkan.
segments.tr: However, it should be noted that the Fed's decision is never certain until it is actually announced.

segments.src: Faktor seperti data inflasi yang tiba-tiba naik, ketegangan geopolitik, atau pernyataan pejabat The Fed yang lebih hati-hati (hawkish) bisa saja mengubah arah kebijakan tersebut.
segments.tr: Factors such as unexpectedly rising inflation data, geopolitical tensions, or more cautious (hawkish) statements from Fed officials could still change this policy direction.

segments.src: ## Tekanan Rupiah dalam Beberapa Bulan Terakhir
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Pressure in Recent Months

segments.src: Selama beberapa bulan terakhir, nilai tukar rupiah terhadap dolar AS tercatat bergerak di kisaran Rp17.800-an, mencerminkan tekanan yang cukup signifikan terhadap mata uang domestik.
segments.tr: Over the past few months, the rupiah exchange rate against the US dollar has been recorded moving in the Rp17,800 range, reflecting quite significant pressure on the domestic currency.

segments.src: Pelemahan ini umumnya dipengaruhi kombinasi faktor eksternal, seperti suku bunga AS yang masih tinggi dan penguatan indeks dolar global, serta faktor internal seperti dinamika neraca perdagangan dan arus modal.
segments.tr: This depreciation is generally driven by a combination of external factors, such as still-high US interest rates and the strengthening of the global dollar index, as well as internal factors like trade balance dynamics and capital flows.

segments.src: Ketika suku bunga AS tinggi, imbal hasil aset berdenominasi dolar cenderung lebih menarik bagi investor global dibandingkan aset di negara berkembang, termasuk Indonesia.
segments.tr: When US rates are high, the yields on dollar-denominated assets tend to be more attractive to global investors compared to assets in developing countries, including Indonesia.

segments.src: Kondisi ini yang selama ini turut menahan penguatan rupiah.
segments.tr: This condition is what has also held back the rupiah's strengthening so far.

segments.src: ## Potensi Dampak bagi Rupiah Jika The Fed Memangkas Bunga
segments.tr: ## Potential Impact on the Rupiah if the Fed Cuts Rates

segments.src: Jika skenario pemangkasan suku bunga The Fed pada September 2026 benar terealisasi, sejumlah analis menilai hal ini berpotensi membuka ruang bagi arus modal asing untuk kembali masuk ke pasar keuangan Indonesia.
segments.tr: If the Fed rate cut scenario in September 2026 truly materializes, a number of analysts believe this could open up room for foreign capital inflows to return to the Indonesian financial market.

segments.src: Beberapa mekanisme yang umum dibahas oleh para pengamat pasar antara lain:
segments.tr: Some mechanisms commonly discussed by market observers include:

segments.src: - **Selisih suku bunga (interest rate differential) yang menyempit** antara AS dan negara berkembang dapat membuat aset rupiah relatif lebih menarik bagi investor asing.
segments.tr: - **Narrowing interest rate differentials** between the US and developing countries can make rupiah assets relatively more attractive to foreign investors.

segments.src: - **Pelemahan indeks dolar AS** secara historis kerap berbanding lurus dengan penguatan mata uang negara berkembang, termasuk rupiah.
segments.tr: - **Weakening of the US dollar index** has historically often been directly proportional to the strengthening of developing country currencies, including the rupiah.

segments.src: - **Sentimen risk-on** di pasar global biasanya mendorong investor mengalihkan sebagian portofolio ke aset emerging market yang menawarkan imbal hasil lebih tinggi.
segments.tr: - **Risk-on sentiment** in global markets usually encourages investors to shift part of their portfolios to emerging market assets offering higher yields.

segments.src: Meski demikian, penting untuk digarisbawahi bahwa penguatan rupiah bukan hal yang otomatis terjadi.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, it is important to underline that the rupiah's strengthening does not happen automatically.

segments.src: Faktor domestik seperti kondisi neraca perdagangan, defisit transaksi berjalan, stabilitas politik, serta kebijakan Bank Indonesia turut berperan besar dalam menentukan arah pergerakan rupiah ke depan.
segments.tr: Domestic factors such as trade balance conditions, the current account deficit, political stability, and Bank Indonesia's policies also play a major role in determining the future direction of the rupiah's movement.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Investor di Indonesia
segments.tr: ## What It Means for Investors in Indonesia

segments.src: Bagi investor domestik, skenario pemangkasan bunga The Fed berpotensi membawa sejumlah implikasi terhadap berbagai kelas aset:
segments.tr: For domestic investors, the Fed rate cut scenario potentially brings several implications across various asset classes:

segments.src: 1. **Pasar saham** — Sektor yang sensitif terhadap suku bunga, seperti perbankan, properti, dan konsumer, kerap menjadi perhatian pelaku pasar saat ekspektasi pelonggaran moneter menguat, karena biaya pendanaan berpotensi menurun.
segments.tr: 1. **Stock market** — Sectors sensitive to interest rates, such as banking, property, and consumer goods, often draw market attention when expectations of monetary easing strengthen, as funding costs potentially decrease.

segments.src: 2. **Pasar obligasi** — Yield Surat Berharga Negara (SBN) berpotensi mengalami penyesuaian seiring perubahan ekspektasi suku bunga global, yang dapat memengaruhi harga obligasi di pasar sekunder.
segments.tr: 2. **Bond market** — Government Securities (SBN) yields potentially experience adjustments along with changes in global interest rate expectations, which can affect bond prices in the secondary market.

segments.src: 3. **Instrumen valuta asing** — Pelaku usaha dengan eksposur impor maupun utang berdenominasi dolar AS perlu mencermati pergerakan rupiah untuk mengelola risiko nilai tukar.
segments.tr: 3. **Foreign exchange instruments** — Business actors with import exposure or US dollar-denominated debt need to monitor rupiah movements to manage exchange rate risk.

segments.src: ## Hal yang Perlu Diperhatikan Investor
segments.tr: ## Things for Investors to Note

segments.src: Beberapa analis mengingatkan agar investor tidak semata-mata berspekulasi berdasarkan satu skenario kebijakan.
segments.tr: Several analysts remind investors not to solely speculate based on a single policy scenario.

segments.src: Beberapa hal yang umum disarankan oleh para pelaku pasar antara lain:
segments.tr: Some things commonly suggested by market players include:

segments.src: - Memantau rilis data ekonomi AS secara berkala, terutama inflasi dan data ketenagakerjaan.
segments.tr: - Regularly monitoring the release of US economic data, especially inflation and employment data.

segments.src: - Mencermati pernyataan resmi pejabat The Fed serta hasil pertemuan Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC).
segments.tr: - Examining official statements from Fed officials and the results of Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

segments.src: - Memperhatikan respons kebijakan Bank Indonesia, termasuk kemungkinan penyesuaian suku bunga acuan BI Rate.
segments.tr: - Paying attention to Bank Indonesia's policy responses, including the possibility of adjustments to the BI Rate benchmark interest rate.

segments.src: - Menjaga diversifikasi portofolio agar tidak terlalu bergantung pada satu skenario pasar tertentu.
segments.tr: - Maintaining portfolio diversification so as not to rely too heavily on one specific market scenario.

segments.src: ## Kesimpulan
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: Ekspektasi pemangkasan suku bunga The Fed pada September 2026 menjadi salah satu katalis yang tengah dicermati pelaku pasar keuangan, termasuk di Indonesia.
segments.tr: Expectations of a Fed rate cut in September 2026 are one of the catalysts being closely watched by financial market players, including in Indonesia.

segments.src: Meski probabilitas pemangkasan diperkirakan berada di kisaran 70 persen menurut sejumlah analis, kepastian arah kebijakan tetap bergantung pada perkembangan data ekonomi terbaru menjelang pertemuan tersebut.
segments.tr: Although the probability of a cut is estimated to be around 70 percent according to a number of analysts, certainty of policy direction still depends on the development of the latest economic data leading up to the meeting.

segments.src: Bagi investor maupun masyarakat umum, penting untuk terus memantau perkembangan informasi dari sumber-sumber resmi dan tepercaya, serta mempertimbangkan situasi keuangan pribadi sebelum mengambil keputusan investasi.
segments.tr: For investors and the general public, it is important to continue monitoring information developments from official and trusted sources, and to consider personal financial situations before making investment decisions.
